Power_voidgate_desc: Open two linked rifts into the Void. Step into one to emerge from the other.
Power_strategy_voidgate_desc:
Each use opens a rift on the surface you look at: first the entrance, then the exit. A new rift replaces the oldest one. Tap the interact key to close both.


You keep your speed and direction through a rift: fall into a rift in the floor to fly out of a rift in a wall. If a rift strands you far below its exit, the interact key also brings you back to where you entered.
Upgrade_power_voidgate_far_desc: Rifts can be opened twice as far away.
Power_strategy_voidgate_far_desc: Doubles the distance at which you can open a rift.
Upgrade_power_voidgate_through_desc: People, bodies and thrown objects pass through rifts.
Power_strategy_voidgate_through_desc:
The Void accepts more than you. Guards, bodies, bottles and grenades pass through rifts and keep their momentum.


Open an exit above a drop and let your pursuers follow you.
Upgrade_power_voidgate_momentum_desc: Bolts, bullets and Windblast pass through rifts.
Power_strategy_voidgate_momentum_desc:
Shoot into one rift to hit whoever stands before the other.


Windblast cast into a rift bursts out of its twin.
